check: what grows in R3 (4K Dolby Vision remux, TrueHD 7.1) on the engine
result: heap, not a buffer: on iphone-a the engine memprobe read mallocMB 101 to 226 over 27 min while AVPlayer held 0.1 to 8 s ahead and 30 s behind and the segment cache stayed on disk at its 2048 MiB budget; the 4K HDR10 AAC row held 62 to 70 MB, R1 58 to 71 MB. On the Mac (Debug walk app, muted, the scratch addon): 15 min of TrueHD 5.1 through the audio bridge held mallocMB 174 to 181; 15 min of Dolby Vision 8.1 (720p, x265 with a dovi_tool RPU and a DOVI record, engine prepared supplemental=dvh1.08.01/db1p DV=profile81) held 159 to 143: neither reproduces the growth on the Mac. Next: the same two clips on iphone-a for 15 min each, then the cap
